infoCategory.title: Sofas Upholstery
infoCategory.description:
Upholstery from the Sofa Collection evolves with the transformation of your living space

The wide selection of upholstery options meets the needs of contemporary interior design, balancing functionality with the elegance of a modern living room.

Personalize each designer sofa with a wide selection of fabrics and leathers, arranged by colour shades: from neutral to melange tones, and from warm, soothing colours to cooler ones. Available in both smooth and textured finishes, the fabrics offer a full sensory and aesthetic experience.
The assortment of leather types – Glove, Perfetto, Magnifica, and Nabuk – stand out for their unique marks and natural imperfections, which enhance their quality and authenticity.

Create a personalised interior design by exploring the endless combinations of our modular sofas and upholstery.
